english: Re-test the soil after 2 to 3 years. One lime application lasts 3 to 5 years.
nyanja_draft: Yesaninso nthaka pakatha zaka 2 kapena 3. Laimu imodzi imagwira ntchito zaka 3 mpaka 5.

english: Lime is not a substitute for fertiliser.
nyanja_draft: Laimu si feteleza. Simungasinthanitse laimu ndi feteleza.

english: Never apply more lime than a soil test supports. Too much lime reduces yield.
nyanja_draft: Musathire laimu yambiri kuposa momwe kuyesa nthaka kukunenera. Laimu yochuluka imachepetsa zokolola.
tonga_final: Kwiina kubika liimu munji mubulongo  kwiindilizya mbuli mbwiiyandika mubulongo

english: Apply lime early and work it into the soil. It needs moisture and time to react.
nyanja_draft: Thirani laimu msanga ndipo muisakanize ndi nthaka. Imafunika chinyezi ndi nthawi kuti igwire ntchito.
tonga_final: Kubika liimu kufwaambana mubulongo. Liimu iyaanda tuumeenda alimwi a chiindi kutegwa isangane a bulongo

english: Soybean: inoculate the seed with the right rhizobia, especially where soybean has not been grown recently.
nyanja_draft: Soya: sakanizani mbewu ndi mankhwala a rhizobia oyenera, makamaka komwe soya sanalimidwe posachedwapa.
tonga_final: Inseke zya soybeans zyeelele kubika inoculant chiindi chakushanga maka- maka mumasena ataaningwa shangidwe soya beans kale

english: Maize: use a suitable seed variety.
nyanja_draft: Chimanga: gwiritsani ntchito mbewu yoyenera.

english: Common fertiliser mistakes: applying too early, too late, or ignoring the weather.
nyanja_draft: Zolakwa zofala ndi feteleza: kuthira msanga kwambiri, mochedwa kwambiri, kapena osaganizira nyengo.
tonga_final: Bulubizyi bwakubika chamutuzhya: kubika chaamutunzhya  kufwambaana, kumuka kubika chaamutunzhya  olo kutalanga or kuchilila chiinda

english: This is decision support only. Consult an extension officer or a soil lab before major spending.
nyanja_draft: Uku ndi kuthandiza kupanga chisankho chabe. Funsani mlangizi wa zaulimi kapena labu ya nthaka musanawononge ndalama zambiri.
tonga_final: Eeci cheendelana aakusa. Amubuzye beendelezi ba zyabulimi muchilawo chenu.

english: The reading did not pass the quality check, so no advice is given. Retake the reading or enter a lab pH.
nyanja_draft: Muyeso sunadutse kuyezedwa kwa khalidwe, choncho palibe malangizo. Yesaninso kapena lowetsani pH ya ku labu.

english: The soil is too acidic for the system to advise safely. Take a sample to a soil lab or an extension officer.
nyanja_draft: Nthaka ndi yowawasa kwambiri kuti tikulangizeni bwino. Tengani chitsanzo cha nthaka ku labu kapena kwa mlangizi wa zaulimi.

english: Lime amount needs the soil texture. Do the texture-by-feel check, then ask again.
nyanja_draft: Kuchuluka kwa laimu kumafunika mtundu wa nthaka. Yesani nthaka ndi manja, kenako funsaninso.

english: The pH is above what {crop} tolerates. Do not apply lime. Get a lab test.

english: It is too late to lime for this season's {crop}. Follow Plan C this season and lime early for next season.

english: The advice depends on how the pH was measured (water or calcium chloride). Get a lab test before buying lime.

english: This much lime must be split into more than one application.

nyanja_draft: Pa pH iyi laimu sikufunika.
